utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll wait for the start time, and once the drop-off spot is set I can help spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send them over today.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll send the final time as soon as it’s confirmed. Thanks for being ready with the tools and tape.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate you spreading the word. If anyone asks, I’m still the point of contact for the updated Sunday plan at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, Rosa — I’ll send folks your way and keep saying Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ve got Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send your task list along to everyone. Thanks, Gus!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Quinn — once you send the task list, I’ll make sure the tools are ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll pass it on right away and keep everyone posted. Thanks again, Gus — we’re set for Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the Sunday time as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — Sunday at the community center is still the plan. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the final time and task list, but the repair drive is Sunday at the community center. If you can bring anything, just tell me and I’ll slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just send the final time and task list when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m still waiting on the final time and task list, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send it your way once I have a moment. Appreciate you helping spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — just send me the Sunday community center details when you have them, and I’ll get it out to everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll send the Sunday community center details your way soon. Thanks again for helping get the word out on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need to confirm the start time, but the repair drive is definitely Sunday at the community center. I’ll share the final timing and drop-off details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — that helps. Once the start time and drop-off spot are posted, I can help point people the right way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Pia — I’ll post the start time and drop-off spot as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes — what do you still need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, I still need the finalized repair list and the photos from you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll send the finalized repair list and photos over soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send me the items you can cover, and I’ll keep the repair drive list updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can cover a few supplies—send me the list and I’ll grab what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send the updated list over, and I’ll keep it organized so we only need to fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I can jump in on the tool table and label the donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’s a huge help. If you spot anything else that needs doing, just let me know and I’ll point you to it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and help wherever needed at the Sunday repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — I’ll keep spreading the Sunday community center update and let folks know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it. If anything shifts again, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll keep everyone in the loop and point them to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, quick update—the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m just confirming the start time and what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works for me. I can bring tools; just send me the start time and a quick list of anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Gus — I’ll send the start time as soon as I lock it in, and for now just bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah — I’ll send the final repair list and photos over soon. Appreciate you being in for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—send it when you can, and I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll send it over soon. Thanks again for being in for Sunday at the community center.
